 Dengue: 3 dead, 1,299 hospitalised in 24 hrs
 Death toll has risen to 371 this year 
 Published : 23 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 23 October 2026, 21:31
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 Three people died of dengue and 1,299 new patients were hospitalised across the country in the 24 hours until 8:00am today.
 Of the deaths, two were reported in Chattogram division and one in Mymensingh division, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest fatalities, the dengue death toll has risen to 371 in the country this year, according to DGHS.
 Since January 1 this year, a total of 119,801 dengue patients were admitted to hospitals across the country. 
 Currently, 6,023 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at different hospitals across the country.
